//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// TestLearningWorkspaceSnapshotPostgres is opt-in. It requires a disposable
// database migrated through the selected-path schema. The snapshot itself is
// read-only: the setup path is written before the reader is called.
func TestLearningWorkspaceSnapshotPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	var installed bool
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.student_learning_context') IS NOT NULL
AND to_regclass('public.student_learning_path_item') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&installed); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !installed {
		t.Skip("selected learning-path schema is not applied to the configured integration database")
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	studentID, courseID, pathID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	readyLessonID, activePracticeID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	_, err := repo.ReplaceLearningPath(ctx, domain.StudentLearningPath{
		ID: pathID, StudentID: studentID, CourseID: courseID, GoalCode: "learn_programming",
		CurriculumRevision: "snapshot-current-planning-revision", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_route", ReasonSummary: "Snapshot test route",
		Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{
			{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: readyLessonID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap"},
			{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: activePracticeID, Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemInProgress, ReasonCode: "active_practice"},
		},
	}, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("seed learning path: %v", err)
	}
	var beforeVersion int64
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT version FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID).Scan(&beforeVersion); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	source, err := repo.ReadLearningWorkspace(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read workspace: %v", err)
	}
	workspace, err := domain.BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(source)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build workspace: %v", err)
	}
	if workspace.Schema != domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema || workspace.ContextVersion != beforeVersion ||
		workspace.SelectedPath == nil || workspace.SelectedPath.LearningPathID != pathID ||
		workspace.SelectedPath.CourseID != courseID || len(workspace.SelectedPath.Items) != 2 ||
		workspace.SelectedPath.Items[0].ReferenceID != readyLessonID ||
		workspace.SelectedPath.Items[1].ReferenceID != activePracticeID ||
		workspace.SelectedPath.Items[1].Status != domain.LearningPathItemInProgress {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected workspace: %#v", workspace)
	}
	var afterVersion int64
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT version FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID).Scan(&afterVersion); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if afterVersion != beforeVersion {
		t.Fatalf("read changed context version before=%d after=%d", beforeVersion, afterVersion)
	}
}
